# Antoine Patraldo — Interactive Portfolio

> Interactive art portfolio of Antoine Patraldo: still and video artworks, AR-viewable pieces, story collections, and browser-based 3D worlds. Artwork media is delivered via Cloudflare Images and Cloudflare Stream.

## Explore

- [Home](https://antoine.patraldo.com/): Main gallery of artworks; each piece can open full size.
- [Collection](https://antoine.patraldo.com/collection): The artwork collection.
- [Stories](https://antoine.patraldo.com/stories): Narrative collections; individual stories are served at /stories/<slug>.
- [Cine gallery](https://antoine.patraldo.com/cine/gallery): Video works, playable via Cloudflare Stream; watch pages at /cine/watch/<id>.
- [Worlds](https://antoine.patraldo.com/worlds): Browser-based 3D worlds.

## Augmented reality

- Individual artworks expose AR view links of the form /ar/image/<id> and /ar/video/<id>, which open the piece in AR on supported mobile devices.

## Access

- [Sign up](https://antoine.patraldo.com/signup) / [Log in](https://antoine.patraldo.com/login): optional viewer account.
